item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] National Park Service says Trump’s proposed arch could diminish historic Washington landmarks
item.description: President Trump's proposed "Triumphal Arch" would have "adverse effects" on dozens of other historic monuments and structures across the Washington skyline, according to the National Parks Service.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Leonardo DiCaprio and Jeff Bezos lead project to save most threatened species
item.description: Foundations funded and co-founded by Leonardo DiCaprio and Jeff Bezos have launched an initiative committing $200 million to revive 100 of Earth's most threatened species, including endangered lemurs, salamanders, pangolins, pigs and echidnas.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] White House to meet with top AI companies ahead of first big regulation push
item.description: The White House is meeting Tuesday with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta to discuss a new framework for reviewing advanced AI before it launches.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Todd Blanche clears key Senate hurdle in bid to be next attorney general
item.description: Todd Blanche cleared a key hurdle Tuesday in his bid to become the nation's next attorney general after the Senate Judiciary Committee voted to advance his nomination.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Report: Most homebuyers are overpaying on their mortgage
item.description: Are you one of the 87% of borrowers overpaying on your mortgage? New research shows the average homeowner loses $3,300 a year — and $78,000 over 30 years. Here's what you can do about it.
